zvec_doc_get_field_value_copy(ZvecNative.zvec_doc_t, String, int, Pointer, SizeTPointer) - Static method in class org.zvec.binding.ZvecNative
 
zvec_doc_get_field_value_copy(ZvecNative.zvec_doc_t, BytePointer, int, PointerPointer, SizeTPointer) - Static method in class org.zvec.binding.ZvecNative
Get field value copy (allocate new memory) Supports all data types including: - Basic types: BOOL, INT32, INT64, UINT32, UINT64, FLOAT, DOUBLE - String types: STRING, BINARY - Vector types: VECTOR_FP32, VECTOR_FP64, VECTOR_FP16, VECTOR_INT4, VECTOR_INT8, VECTOR_INT16, VECTOR_BINARY32, VECTOR_BINARY64 - Sparse vector types: SPARSE_VECTOR_FP32, SPARSE_VECTOR_FP16 - Array types: ARRAY_STRING, ARRAY_BINARY, ARRAY_BOOL, ARRAY_INT32, ARRAY_INT64, ARRAY_UINT32, ARRAY_UINT64, ARRAY_FLOAT, ARRAY_DOUBLE The returned value pointer must be manually freed using appropriate deallocation functions (zvec_free() for basic types and strings, zvec_free_uint8_array() for binary data).
zvec_doc_get_field_value_copy(ZvecNative.zvec_doc_t, BytePointer, int, Pointer, SizeTPointer) - Static method in class org.zvec.binding.ZvecNative
 
zvec_doc_get_field_value_pointer(ZvecNative.zvec_doc_t, String, int, Pointer, SizeTPointer) - Static method in class org.zvec.binding.ZvecNative
 
zvec_doc_get_field_value_pointer(ZvecNative.zvec_doc_t, BytePointer, int, PointerPointer, SizeTPointer) - Static method in class org.zvec.binding.ZvecNative
Get field value pointer (data remains in document) Supports data types where direct pointer access is safe: - Basic types: BOOL, INT32, INT64, UINT32, UINT64, FLOAT, DOUBLE - String types: STRING (returns null-terminated C string), BINARY - Vector types: VECTOR_FP32, VECTOR_FP64, VECTOR_FP16, VECTOR_INT4, VECTOR_INT8, VECTOR_INT16, VECTOR_BINARY32, VECTOR_BINARY64 - Array types: ARRAY_INT32, ARRAY_INT64, ARRAY_UINT32, ARRAY_UINT64, ARRAY_FLOAT, ARRAY_DOUBLE The returned pointer points to data within the document object and does not require manual memory management.
